case.description: Severe round-064-style wedge for observing the worst tilt: a static, laser-invisible 0.06 m wall (top at 0.06 m, below the 0.107 m scan plane) centred at (0.45, 0) on the first fitted leg. The robot pitches ~39 deg on contact and the bounded escape probes both directions with ~0 m displacement, so this variant demonstrates the wedge the recovery layer cannot free; watch roll/pitch climb and the 'Failed to get a plan' loop.
